Frequently Asked Questions

When was Danny MacFayden born?

Danny MacFayden was born on June 10, 1905.

Where was Danny MacFayden born?

Danny MacFayden was born in North Truro, MA.

How tall was Danny MacFayden?

Danny MacFayden was 5-11 (180 cm) tall.

How much did Danny MacFayden weigh when playing?

Danny MacFayden weighed 170 lbs (77 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Danny MacFayden play?

Danny MacFayden played 17 seasons.

Is Danny MacFayden in the Hall of Fame?

Danny MacFayden has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Danny MacFayden play?

Danny MacFayden was a Pitcher.

How many strikeouts did Danny MacFayden have?

Danny MacFayden had 797 strikeouts over his career.

How many teams has Danny MacFayden played for?

Danny MacFayden played for 6 teams; the Boston Braves, Boston Red Sox, Cincinnati Reds, Washington Nationals, New York Yankees and Pittsburgh Pirates.

How many World Series has Danny MacFayden won?

Danny MacFayden won 1 World Series.

When did Danny MacFayden retire?

Danny MacFayden last played in 1943.

What are Danny MacFayden's nicknames?

Deacon Danny is a nickname for Danny MacFayden.
